source: official locomo10.json; unchanged original QA and categories

development.selection: first two conversations in original source order, all QA; no answer-dependent selection

embedding: local bge-small-en-v1.5; verified snapshots recorded per run
scoring: unchanged upstream-compatible ordinary F1 and adversarial literal refusal rule
cost: all Reader, planner, assessor, verifier and failed attempts; missing usage is unknown
gate_validation: official unanswerable category vs direct-answer-literal supported development cases; restricted proxy, not human semantic sufficiency gold
acceptance: report F1, adversarial refusal, structured statuses, complete failures and known tokens/case together; no default promotion on F1 alone
independence: existing full corpus has already been examined; new development split is not a previously unseen benchmark
production: use_answer_risk opt-in; normally3/max5 calls including gate and support repair; no adaptive production retrieval
refinements: field-typed verbatim utterance/date quotes; same-turn date anchors do not establish events alone
retain all previously displayed evidence before bounded supplements
stop repeated unsupported/conflict after first targeted round
reject answer status containing canonical refusal
missing/conflict aggregate must match explicit requirements; no automatic promotion on contract repair
reserve complete Reader/support/one support retry before Reader; other calls cannot consume held allowance
compact verifier instructions,2048 output tokens,typed length failure with all attempts/usage retained
supplement_retention: all prior presented sources plus at most80 ranked additional sources; evidence budget still enforced
execution_status: engineering validated only; not executed; no new benchmark scores

verification_policy.repair: complete JSON regeneration; inconsistent negative cannot become sufficient
verification_policy.output_length: one bounded regeneration; repeated length remains engineering failure
verification_policy.reader_support_reservation: atomic reader + support + one support retry; calls and complete input bytes
verification_policy.unused_reservations: released, never charged as actual usage
